title: Bikewatching
description: Interactive Mapbox + D3 map of ~260K Bluebikes trips from March 2024. Circle size shows traffic at each Boston/Cambridge station, color shows whether riders are mostly arriving or departing, and a time slider filters by time of day.

title: Persuasive Visualization: Climate Disasters
description: DSC 106 group project. A persuasive visualization built on the proposition that climate-related disasters are becoming more frequent.

title: DonkeyCar Autonomous Vehicle
description: DSC 190 project training a self-driving RC car. Collected driving data on the physical car, moved it from the Raspberry Pi to UCSD's DSMLP GPU cluster, and trained models with TensorFlow.

title: WildGuess
description: Hackathon build: a Wordle-style guessing game about San Diego wildlife, written in plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Prosthetic Arm Project
description: Using machine learning, Python, and GitHub to build a fully functional prosthetic arm with the Triton NeuroTech club at UCSD.

title: Water Polo Stats Project
description: Collected data throughout the season and compiled a data dashboard in Power BI. Used graphs and visuals to highlight important game stats such as goals per shot. Summarized our season at a glance and helped my coach adjust the lineup for next year.
